mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls growth above 0.3 percentage points signals improved labor market momentum, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of accelerating payrolls (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 5% signals weakening residential demand, which reduces construction-related earnings and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sharp housing starts declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below -0.5% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate revenues and profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of industrial production contraction (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the federal funds rate combined with a 2-month decline in CPI above 0.5% signals a coordinated easing stance, which lowers borrowing costs and inflation risk, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during coordinated easing episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month sustained unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and cost-push inflation, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of persistently low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Income above 1% signals weakening household purchasing power, which reduces consumer spending and corporate revenues, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sharp income declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in Industrial Production above 0.5% signals improving manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate revenues and profit margins, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of accelerating industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).
